workspace.purge.intro: Removes what Combwork keeps: its backups of the transcripts (the archive's too), attachments, and what is left of deleted sessions. The coding agents' own files (in ~/.claude, ~/.codex and ~/.copilot) are never touched, and running sessions are left alone. What the sessions used stays in the usage history, so the totals don't change.

workspace.welcome.flowText: Combwork chimes and notifies you when an agent finishes or needs input — even from the system tray.
workspace.welcome.projectsText: Each subfolder is a project. Toggle the ones you're working on; each gets its own coding agents, running side by side.
workspace.welcome.skillsText: Combwork skills in the workspace reach the agents of every project (and the Assistant, for those written for it); each project also shows its own and your user skills. An MCP server is on only where you turn it on: in one project, or in all of them. Changes apply to new sessions.
workspace.welcome.tagline: Run AI coding agents across your projects, side by side.
workspace.welcome.workspaceText: A folder of projects. Combwork adds a .combwork folder for shared notes, skills and MCP servers — commit it to share with your team.
